description_text:
Description
Ascard 75 is enteric coated Acetylsalicylic Acid (Aspirin) available in tablet form in 75 mg. Aspirin belongs to a group of drugs called antiplatelet agents that help prevent your blood cells from sticking together to form a blood clot. Aspirin 75 mg Tablets are principally used to prevent blood clots from forming following a heart attack or stroke to prevent heart attacks in patients who have previously suffered from these condtions.
How to use
The recommended dose is one tablet once daily or as directed by your doctor.
Precautions
Discontinue Ascard 75 mg Tablet right away and notify your doctor if you have ringing in your ears, abnormal bleeding, or nausea or vomiting that doesn't go away. Do not use Ascard 75 mg Tablet for children <18 years of age as it may cause neurological side effects. People with nasal polyp and asthma can have a severe allergy to Ascard 75 mg. Common side effects include: Gastrointestinal irritation, Nausea, Vomiting, Dyspepsia, Gastritis, Bleeding disorder, Low blood platelets, Gastric erosion, Gastric ulcer.

description_html:

8-12 years: Two 5 ml spoonfuls (200 mg) three to four times a day.

name: Cipladon 1000mg Effervescent Tabs 8's
description_html:
Description
Cipladon contains Paracetamol 1000 mg effervescent. It is used for the relief of headache including migraine, neuralgia, toothache, period pain, and rheumatic aches and pains. Symptomatic relief of colds, influenza and sore throats.
How to use
For oral administration only. Dissolve the tablets of Cipladon 1g in water (about 200 ml) before swallowing.
Adults, the elderly and children over 16 years: One or two tablets to be taken up to four times daily. Maximum dose of 8 tablets in 24 hours.
Children 12-15 years : One tablet,every 4-6 hours when necessary to a maximum of 4 doses in 24 hours.
Children under 12 years of age: Not recommended.
Precautions
The dose should not be repeated more frequently than every 4 hours, and not more than 4 doses should be taken in any 24 hour period. Dosage should not be continued for more than 3 days without consulting a doctor. Hypersensitivity to paracetamol and/or other constituents. Do not take with any other paracetamol-containing products.

Apply a pea-sized amount (0.2 grams) of Dentinox Teething Gel with a clean finger to the affected area of gum.

name: Quadrajel 15g
description_html:
Quadrajel Gel is a combination medicine used in the treatment of mouth ulcers. It promotes the healing of mouth ulcers by forming a protective coating over the mouth sores. It also blocks the transmission of pain signals to the brain to decrease the sensation of pain.

Quadrajel Gel should be used strictly as advised by your doctor. Use it in the dose and duration as directed by your doctor. You should not use more quantity or more often than prescribed by your doctor. This will not make it work any faster but rather increase the chance of side effects.

Using this medicine may cause some common side effects such as application site reactions (burning, irritation, itching, and redness), dryness in the mouth, metallic taste, nausea, and staining of teeth. These are usually temporary and resolve with time. If they do not get better with time or worsen, you should let your doctor know. Your doctor may be able to suggest ways of preventing or reducing the side effects.

Before using the medicine, it is important to tell your doctor if you are using or have recently used any other medicines for the same condition or other diseases. To make sure the medicine is safe, pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before using the medicine.

name: Bio-oil Dry Skin Gel 50ml
description_html:
There are billions of dry skin sufferers across the globe, most of whom are using a dry skin product on a regular basis. Dry skin is, however, the biggest unmet need in skincare, so it must be assumed that many dry skin sufferers are looking for a better dry skin product.

Traditional dry skin products such as creams, lotions and body butters are made primarily from water – usually around 70%. This water evaporates when coming into contact with skin and is of no benefit to dry skin. It's often what causes the cold sensation that you feel when applying these products. Bio-Oil Dry Skin Gel is made from oil, so feels "warm" on application.

Bio Oil Dry Skin Gel uses pioneering technology to replace the in-active water found in creams and lotions with skin nourishing oils, making the product 100% active and 100% effective in restoring dry skin. This next generation in the treatment of dry skin is delivered in a breakthrough new gel format that replenishes the skin’s barrier and deeply moisturises. Its unique gel-to-oil texture absorbs easily and creates a protective film to resist moisture loss and restore dry skin to its optimal hydrated state. With just 3% water, this highly potent formulation blends emollients such as shea butter and humectants like glycerine and urea, along with skin soothing ingredients such as vitamin B3 for an exceptional moisturizing result

name: Bio-oil Lotion 175ml
description_html: Bio-Oil® Body Lotion pioneers a new level of lightness and efficacy in body moisturisation. The product is significantly thinner than currently available body lotions1, yet has a high-oil loading of 42%. This unique combination of being ultralight yet high in oil is made possible by Bio-Oil’s pioneering ‘shake before use’ formulation. Body lotions are popular because they are light and easily absorbed, allowing the user to get dressed immediately after application. They are, however, due to their lightness, typically less effective than creams and body butters. With Bio-Oil Body Lotion we set out to investigate whether we could make a body lotion as effective, if not more effective, as creams and body butters and at the same time make it ultralight. This was eventually achieved with a pioneering ‘shake before use’ formulation design that allows the lotion to be ultralight yet highly effective. Through the unique formulation, Bio-Oil Body Lotion’s clinically efficacious high-oil formulation is delivered in a non-greasy ultralight fluid lotion. The product spreads easily, absorbs quickly and leaves only a silky, soft and smooth after feel on the skin. Satisfying both moisturisation and sensorial preferences.

name: Eucerin Urea Repair Plus 10% Urea Lotion 250ml
description_html:
Eucerin UreaRepair PLUS 10% Urea Lotion gives very dry, rough body skin the daily care it needs. It contains a unique combination of ingredients – Urea, Ceramide and other Natural Moisturizing Factors (NMFs) – which bind moisture in and repair skin´s natural protective barrier to prevent further moisture loss. The formula has been clinically and dermatologically proven to deliver immediate relief and intense, long-lasting moisturization, delaying dryness and roughness for up to 48 hours. Skin is intensely moisturized and looks and feels smooth and supple again.
When the skin on our bodies has a stable barrier function, it protects us from external irritants and is able to maintain its optimal level of hydration. But when that barrier is impaired, skin can lose moisture and look and feel dry as a result.

How to use
1. Gently massage the lotion into your skin until completely absorbed
2. Apply as often as required

name: Duspatalin 135mg Tablets 50's
description_html:
Duspatalin belongs to the group of medicines called antispasmodics. This medicine is used to treat symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) and similar problems such as chronic irritable colon, spastic constipation, mucous colitis and spastic colitis. Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) is a very common condition which causes spasm and pain in the gut or intestine. The intestine is a long muscular tube which food passes down so it can be digested. If the intestine goes into spasm and squeezes too tightly, you get pain. The way this medicine works is by relieving the spasm, pain and other symptoms of IBS.
The main symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) include:
• stomach pain and spasm • feeling bloated and having wind • having diarhoea (with or without constipation) • small, hard, pellet-like or ribbon-like stools (feces)
These symptoms may vary from person to person.

By using the Weeks Indicator Pregnancy Test, you can avoid unnecessary worries and gain clarity about your pregnancy. This test allows you to make informed decisions about your future planning and care.

categories: Medical Diagnostic > Diagnostics > Self Test Kits > HIV
description_html:
Sure Check HIV Self Test is a home-use HIV testing kit that allows you to test yourself for HIV (human immunodeficiency virus) in the privacy of your own home. HIV is a virus that can lead to AIDS (acquired immune deficiency syndrome) if left untreated. The Sure Check HIV Self Test is designed to detect the presence of HIV antibodies in a person's blood.

To use the test, you will need to collect a small sample of blood using the lancet and test strip provided in the kit. The test strip is inserted into the test reader, and the results are displayed within 15 minutes. The test is over 99% accurate when used according to the instructions.

It is important to note that the Sure Check HIV Self-Test is not intended to diagnose HIV infection. If you test positive on the self-test, you should contact your healthcare provider for further testing and treatment. If you test negative, it is still important to practice safe sex and to get tested regularly to ensure that you remain HIV-negative.

The Importance Of Omega-3 Fatty Acids

Omega-3 fatty acids are a special class of polyunsaturated fatty acids which are commonly found in plant seed oils, nut oils and oily fish such as sardines and mackerel. A large number of scientific studies worldwide have highlighted the multiple benefits of dietary Omega-3 fatty acids in areas as diverse as heart, brain, and normal vision. The two most researched Omega-3 fatty acids are Docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) and Eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA). DHA contributes to the maintenance of normal vision1.

DHA In The Retina

Omega-3 fatty acids play an important structural and functional role in the retina, the part of the eye that detects light. DHA is a component of photoreceptor cells which are responsible for converting light into nerve signals. Photoreceptors contain the highest concentration of DHA of any cell in the body, with DHA accounting for over 50% of the total fatty acid content2 3. Adequate levels of DHA must be maintained for the retina to continue to function properly and to maintain normal vision)4 5.

The retinal cells are continually being renewed, so a constant supply of Omega-3 fatty acids and in particular DHA is required6 7. Since these cannot be made by the body a lack of these in the diet can have a direct effect on levels in the retina8. Fortunately increasing dietary intake can help to restore retinal Omega-3 levels9. Omega-3 fatty acids are now being recognised as being essential for normal eye health from before birth continuing into old age10.

Protection Of Cells

The macular is the central area of the retina, and contains the highest density of photoreceptors. The retinal cells of the macular are particularly vulnerable to the effects of UV rays in sunlight which can result in cellular damage11 12. Because of this, sunglasses with a high Eye-Sun Protection Factor (E-SPF) are always recommended to reduce the exposure of the eye to excessive light and harmful UV rays.

Visionace Plus provides vitamins C and E, plus minerals zinc and selenium which contribute to the protection of cells from oxidative stress.

Advanced Comprehensive Formula

Visionace also contains a comprehensive range of vitamins, minerals and nutrients, such as copper and selenium which support the normal functioning of the immune system, and thiamin (vitamin B1) which contribute to the normal function of the heart. An additional multivitamin is not required.

The beneficial effect is obtained with a daily intake of 250mg of DHA.

description_html:
Modern living can leave our eyes feeling tired, uncomfortable or irritated. Computer use, air conditioning and irritants such as dust, grit or smoke can damage the surface of the eye leaving it in need of some TLC. Suitable for
Suitable for adults and children

How to use

Optrex Multi Action Eye Wash comes with a single eye bath for application.
Ensure your hands are clean and dry and the bottle’s seal is intact.
Pour the wash into the eye bath until it’s about a third full. Bend your head forward, holding the eye bath by its base.
Place the eye bath over your eye and slowly raise your head with your eye open, so wash flows into it.
Gently rock your head from side to side for at least 30 seconds.
If the eye bath is likely to be used by more than one person it is a sensible precaution to sterilize it by boiling it in water.
Optrex Multi Action Eye Wash is suitable for everyday use.

categories: Personal Care > Eyecare and Earcare > Eyecare
description_html:
Tears Naturale II Lubricant Eye Drops is a dry eye therapy for the temporary relief of burning and irritation due to dryness of the eye.

Tears Naturale II contains Hydroxypropyl Methylcellulose 0.3% w/v which is used in the treatment of dry eyes. Tears Naturale II Eye Drop is a lubricant. It works similar to natural tears and provides temporary relief from burning and discomfort due to dryness of the eye.
How to use
This medicine is for external use only. Take it in the dose and duration as advised by your doctor. Hold the dropper close to the eye without touching it. Gently squeeze the dropper and place the medicine inside the lower eyelid. Wipe off extra liquid.
Apply pressure on the corner of the eye (close to the nose) for about 1 minute immediately after instilling the drop.
Wait for at least 5-10 minutes before delivering the next medication in the same eye to avoid dilution.

Nizoral shampoo contains the active ingredient ketoconazole, which is a type of medicine called an antifungal. It is used to treat skin infections with fungi and yeasts.

Ketoconazole is used to prevent and treat a number of different types of fungal and yeast infections. Ketoconazole shampoo is used to treat skin conditions that are caused by infection with the yeast Pityrosporum, also known as Malassezia. These include the skin infection pityriasis versicolor, as well as seborrhoeic dermatitis and dandruff, which is considered to be a mild form of seborrhoeic dermatitis.

Like other shampoos, Nizoral shampoo also contains ingredients to clean your hair.

name: Blistex Cold Sore Cream DocosanolTube 2gm
description_html:
Blistex Cold Sore Cream is a clinically proven treatment for the early stages of recurrent cold sores on the lips. it contains Docosanol which works differently to other treatments in the early stages of a cold sore.

adults and adolescents aged 12 years and over:

at the first sign of a recurrent cold sore, apply to the affected area 5 times a day, at approximately 3 hourly intervals until healed, for a maximum of 10 days. do not start treatment with cream at the stage of an already developed blister or ulcer.

for full details read before use and retain the enclosed patient information leaflet. warnings and precautions:

  • do not use if sensitive to Docosanol or any other ingredients.
  • children under 12 should not use Docosonal 10 % cream.
  • do not use and consult your doctor if you have a weakened immune system.
  • should only be used for cold sores on the mouth and face.
  • avoid getting the cream into the eyes.

if symptoms do not improve after 10 days, or if they worsen, consult your doctor.

what is a cold sore?

a cold sore starts with a tingling, burning sensation to the lip. a blister then appears within 48 hours and can take up to ten days to fully heal. flu, fatigue, stress and extreme weather conditions are just a few of the common triggers for cold sores, meaning that many people tend to suffer more cold sores during the colder months of the year.

the blister may spread and be irritating or painful whilst it heals, so it’s advised to use a treatment such as Blistex cold sore cream to help aid the healing process.

1 g contains 100 mg (10 %) docosanol. also contains sucrose stearates, light mineral oil, propylene glycol (e1520), benzyl alcohol (e1519), purified water.New Blistex Cold Sore cream is a new way to treat cold sores. It's different. Because only new Blistex Cold Sore Cream has docosanol which when applied at first tingle penetrates the skin to help block the virus. Only available from pharmacies. Blistex Cold Sore Cream. A new way to treat cold sores.

name: Eucerin Even Pigment Perfector Dual Serum 30ML
description_html:
Melanin is a natural pigment that gives color to skin. Exposure to sunlight, hormonal influences and aging can cause an increase in melanin production and trigger hyperpigmentation. Hyperpigmentation appears as dark patches and age spots (also known as sun spots) that make skin look uneven.

Eucerin Even Pigment Perfector Dual Serum brings together two serums that work in different ways:

Dermatologists use Hyaluronic Acid injections and skin peels to rejuvenate aging skin. Inspired by these treatments, Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler Night Peeling & Serum combines two powerful formulas for multiple anti-aging benefits:
A refined skin texture and radiance: The creamy emulsion contains an effective AHA (alpha-hydroxy-acid) Complex and Glycine Saponin. AHAs, many of them known as Fruit Acids, exfoliate skin while Glycine Saponin supports the production of Hyaluronic Acid in the dermal layer where deeper wrinkles originate.
Moisturization and wrinkle-filling: The transparent gel combines concentrated high and low molecular Hyaluronic Acid. High molecular Hyaluronic Acid works to smooth the external layers of skin while the low molecular Hyaluronic Acid (which is 40 times smaller) penetrates further into the epidermal layers where deeper wrinkles originate.
The two formulas combine on your skin to make it feel smooth. This innovative product is designed to be used overnight and, when used regularly, Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler Night Peeling & Serum is clinically and dermatologically proven to refine skin texture and promote skin cell renewal while plumping up even the deepest wrinkles. Skin is smoother and more radiant and pores are refined.
How to use
1. Apply once a day, in the evening, to a well cleansed face, neck and décolleté
2. Press the top of dispenser in the middle to release the optimum combination of both formulas
3. Mix the two formulas together in the palm of your hand
4. Avoid direct contact with your eyes
5. The product may increase skin’s sensitivity to the sun so ensure you use a minimum SPF 30 day cream every day after using the product and for a week after use.
6. For best results, use in combination with other products in the Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler range

How To Use:

Cleansing the wound from dirt and bacteria is an essential first step to enable optimal healing. To prevent wound infections, spray the Elastoplast Wound Spray from a distance of approximately 10 cm onto the entire wound area. Repeat if necessary, then gently dry the wound and surrounding skin area.


Important: A minor wound will soon stop bleeding. If it continues, apply pressure with a gauze pad or Non-Stick Dressing, keep pressure on the wound and seek medical advice.

Next, it’s important to protect the wound from external influences like dirt and bacteria to enable undisturbed healing. Cover your wound with the Elastoplast plaster or dressing that best suits your needs. Observe your wound and change the plaster or dressing regularly unless you’ve been recommended to do otherwise by your doctor

description_html:
Elastoplast Fabric 18's - Fabric plasters for wound protection

Elastoplast plasters block 99% of dirt and bacteria.

  • The flexible fabric dries quickly and doesn't get soggy.
  • The waterproof and breathable plaster membrane keeps the wound dry and protected from dirt and bacteria.
  • The strong adhesion sticks reliably without leaving any residues.

These plasters are available as 18 strips.

Hi-DRY TEX Technology Elastoplast developed this three-layer technology for improved wound protection. Hi-DRY TEX technology makes the plaster waterproof, breathable and ensures strong adhesion, due to its integrated coverage of flexible fabric and a waterproof, yet breathable membrane. The flexible fabric ensures not only utmost comfort for you, but also protection from moisture and water for your wound..

How To Use:

Cleanse

Cleansing the wound from dirt and bacteria is an essential first step to enable optimal healing. To prevent wound infections, spray the Elastoplast Wound Spray from a distance of approximately 10 cm onto the entire wound area. Repeat if necessary, then gently dry the wound and surrounding skin area.

Protect

Next, it’s important to protect the wound from external influences like dirt and bacteria to enable undisturbed healing. Cover your wound with a sterile wound dressing that best suits your needs. Observe your wound and change the plaster or dressing regularly unless you’ve been recommended to do otherwise by your doctor.

Heal

Help your wound heal safely, quickly and with a lower risk of scarring. Apply Elastoplast Wound Healing Ointment regularly until your wound has healed completely. Carefully apply a thin film one to two times per day. Make sure the opening of the tube does not get in contact with your wound. Repeat regularly until the healing is completed. The Elastoplast Wound Healing Ointment can be used on open minor superficial wounds and at any stage of the healing process. If necessary, cover the wound with a plaster, dressing or compress

categories: Personal Care > Hair Care > Hair Hygiene
description_html:
Nizoral shampoo contains the active ingredient ketoconazole, which is a type of medicine called an antifungal. It is used to treat skin infections with fungi and yeasts.

Ketoconazole is used to prevent and treat a number of different types of fungal and yeast infections. Ketoconazole shampoo is used to treat skin conditions that are caused by infection with the yeast Pityrosporum, also known as Malassezia. These include the skin infection pityriasis versicolor, as well as seborrhoeic dermatitis and dandruff, which is considered to be a mild form of seborrhoeic dermatitis.

Like other shampoos, Nizoral shampoo also contains ingredients to clean your hair.

name: Eucerin Sun Even Pigment Protector Fluid 50ml
description_html:
Eucerin Even Pigment Perfector Sun Fluid SPF 50+ is an everyday facial sunscreen for all skin types that helps to prevent sun-induced hyperpigmentation. The Advanced Spectral Technology combines broadband and photostable UVA/UVB filters1 for very high UV protection with Licochalcone A to neutralize free radicals caused by UV and HEVIS light. The anti-pigment sunscreen also includes Glycyrrhetinic Acid which supports skin’s own DNA repair mechanism.
UV light is the main cause of sun-induced skin damage, but high-energy visible (HEVIS) light can also induce free radicals that cause further stress to skin. Sunlight triggers an increase in melanin production which may lead to hyperpigmentation concerns such as sun spots.
The formula is further enriched with Thiamidol, an effective and patented ingredient that acts at the root cause of hyperpigmentation. It visibly reduces dark spots over time and, when used regularly, prevents their re-appearance.
Eucerin Even Pigment Perfector Sun Fluid SPF 50+ has a pleasant light texture that absorbs quickly and is clinically and dermatologically proven to be well tolerated, even by sensitive skin.
How to use
1. Apply in the morning after, or instead of, your regular day care product
2. Can be used in combination with other Eucerin Face Care products such as those in the Eucerin Anti-Pigment range
3. Your skin is instantly protected from the sun – no waiting time required.
4. Follow with make-up if appropriate

description_html:
Extra-Strength Vitamin D3 Support

Jamieson's Extra Strength Vitamin D3 Chewables are great tasting and deliver 2,500 IU of pure, naturally sourced vitamin D3 to help prevent vitamin D deficiency. This extra strength formula is great way to boost your intake of Vitamin D with a higher potency dose in a convenient single serving.

  • Helps to prevent vitamin D deficiency
  • Vitamin D intake, when combined with sufficient calcium, a healthy diet and regular exercise may reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis in people with vitamin D deficiency
  • Delicious, tangy orange flavoured chewable tablets
  • Formulated with high-quality sourced vitamin D

Ingredients

Each Tablet Contains:
Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol) 62.5 mcg/2,500 IU

Non-Medicinal Ingredients:

Dextrose, cellulose, citric acid, vegetable stearic acid, natural orange flavours, vegetable magnesium stearate, silica, sucralose.
NO gluten, lactose, artificial colours, flavours or preservatives.

Directions

Adults: Chew 1 tablet daily. To be taken with an adequate intake of calcium. Consult a health care practitioner for use beyond 6 months.

Number of Servings: 75

Warnings

15-20 mcg (600-800 IU) of vitamin D per day is adequate for most individuals. Consult a health care practitioner to determine if you would benefit from additional vitamin D before taking this product.
Do not use this product if you have hypercalcemia and/or hypercalciuria. Consult a health care practitioner prior to use if you: are pregnant or breastfeeding; have a kidney disorder; take other vitamin D supplements, multivitamin supplements containing vitamin D, or products containing vitamin D analogues; take any prescription medications including antacids, anticonvulsants, digoxin, cholestyramine, colestipol, mineral oil, steroids, statins or thiazide diuretics.
Stop use and consult a health care practitioner if weakness, fatigue, drowsiness, headache, lack of appetite, dry mouth, metallic taste, nausea, vomiting, vertigo, ringing in the ears, lack of coordination and muscle weakness occur, which are early symptoms of hypercalcemia, or if you have any other side effects.

name: Nature's Aid Vitamin B12 90's
description_html:
Vitamin B12 is a member of the B Vitamin family, and like all the others, it is water-soluble and required to be consumed daily to support numerous different bodily functions. Vitamin B12 is well known for its role in supporting the formation of red blood cells, as well as helping to reduce tiredness and fatigue. Other roles played by Vitamin B12 include:

  • Supporting normal energy-producing metabolism
  • Supporting healthy psychological function
  • Supporting the nervous system.

Vitamin B12 is mainly found in animal-sourced foods, so it is thought that those following a vegan diet may be at risk of suffering from Vitamin B12 deficiency. Those on long term antacid tablets may also be at risk of low B12 because the action of these medications may impact the body’s ability to absorb Vitamin B12.

name: Nature's Aid Folic Acid 400Ug 90's
description_html:
Folic Acid is the supplementary form of folate. Folate is naturally found in a number of foods, with the best sources including green leafy vegetables (like spinach and kale), avocado and eggs. Your diet could be low in folate if you do not eat these foods on a regular basis. Pregnancy is also a time when low folate could be an issue. Supplemental folic acid intake increases maternal folate levels. Low levels of folate during pregnancy have been identified as a risk factor in the development of neural tube defects in the developing foetus. This is why it is often suggested that women trying to conceive and those who are newly pregnant use a folic acid supplement.

Folate is not just helpful to health during pregnancy, it helps to support the immune system, contributes to normal psychological function and reduces tiredness and fatigue.

Natures Aid Folic Acid provides 400 μg in each vegan friendly tablet. For complete peace of mind this supplement is also gluten, dairy, soya, nut, and yeast free.

name: Accurate Malaria Rapid Deep stick Test Cassette 1's
categories: Medical Diagnostic > Diagnostics > Self Test Kits > Malaria
description_html:
The Malaria P.f./P.v./Pan Rapid Test Cassette (Whole Blood) is a qualitative, membrane based immunoassay for the detection of P.f., P.v., P.o. and P.m. antigens in whole blood. The membrane is pre-coated with anti-HRP-II antibodies, anti-p.v. LDH and anti-pan LDH antibodies. During testing, the whole blood specimen reacts with the dye conjugate, which has been pre-coated on the test cassette. The mixture then migrates upward on the membrane by capillary action, reacts with anti-Histidine-Rich Protein II (HRP-II) antibodies on the membrane on P.f. test line region, with anti-p.v. LDH antibodies on the membrane on

P.v. line region and with anti-pan LDH antibodies on the membrane on Pan line region. If the specimen contains HRP-II, p.v. LDH and/or pan LDH, colored line (s) will appear in P.f. line region, P.v. and/or Pan line region. The absence of the colored lines in P.f. line region,

P.v. line region and/or Pan line region indicates that the specimen does not contain HRP-II,

P.v. LDH and/or Plasmodium-specific LDH. To serve as a procedure control, a colored line will always appear in the control line region indicating that proper volume of specimen has been added and membrane wicking has occurred.

name: Thuasne Ligastrap Malleo Size 4
description_html:
The Ligastrap Malleo is an ankle brace that provides reinforcement of the lateral ligaments thanks to the elastic compressive knit of around 27.5 mmHg and double strapping. A removable strap provides additional reinforcement and places the foot in a slight eversion. Minimum thickness and velcro attachment ensure a comfortable fit and the Ligastrap Malleo has an anti-slip system on the calf for a better hold.

Features

  • Figure 8 strapping for lateral stabilization and support
  • Removable reinforcement strap
  • Anti-slip system to prevent migration
  • Patented pull tabs for easy application and removal
  • Low profile for maximum comfort
  • Universal left or right
  • Indications:
    • Mild ankle sprain (acute phase).
    • Post-operative, post-traumatic residual pain and/or oedema.
    • Joint instability/laxity.
    • Proprioceptive support for rehabilitation.
    • Sport activities resumption.
    • Compression for scar/burns healing.

name: Thuasne Genu Dynastab Size 6
description_html:
• Genu Dynastab® by Thuasne is a bi-axial hinged ligament knee brace for functional treatment of knee injuries and sprains. This assists the wearer to resume activities following knee injuries and sprains in sports and high-risk professions.

    Anatomically-shaped, designed and knitted to ensure even compression and better morphological adjustment to personalise the comfort zone around the back of the knees.

    Maximum stability is achieved with the removable dual hinge side reinforcements plus semi-rigid strapping giving extra support and preventing unwanted movement.

    Made using stretch weave fabric and perforated neoprene, perspiration buildup is greatly reduced thanks to neoprene’s evaporative properties.

    Silicone-coated threads at the top of the knee brace and anti-tourniquet straps provide optimum hold of the brace on the leg to ensure a comfortable hold.

    The kneecap is supported and held in-place with a silicone patellar insert.

    Patented pull tabs make for easy on and easy off brace removal.Dual hinge design provides stability

  • Patented pull tabs for easy application and removal
  • Universal left or right

name: Medisign Blood Glucose Strips
description_html: The Medisign® MS-2 Blood glucose Test Strip is designed for use with the Medisign® MM1200 Blood glucose Meter. The test Strips are intended for qualitative measurement of the concentration of glucose in capillary whole blood from fingertip, palm, and forearm by diabetic patients or healthcare professionals as aid in the management of diabetes. It’s intended for use outside of the body (In Vitro Diagnostic Use) and not for diagnosis or screening for diabetes, nor for use on neonates or arterial blood. The alternative site testing (palm and forearm in these system can only be used during steady state blood glucose conditions.

description_html:

Off White
  • Zero-Calorie Sweetener
  • Quick Dissolving

NOW® BetterStevia® is a zero-calorie, low glycemic sweetener that makes a perfect substitute for table sugar and artificial sweeteners. Unlike chemical sweeteners, NOW® BetterStevia® contains a certified organic Stevia extract. NOW takes special measures to preserve Stevia’s native qualities in this unique, organic, better-tasting Stevia.

DIRECTIONS

Use to naturally sweeten your favorite beverages. Dissolve 1 tablet in 4-8 oz. of a beverage, as desired daily. Sweeten to taste.

NOW® BetterStevia™ Instant Tabs are a convenient way to use this natural sweetener. The tablets dissolve best in hot liquids, however some cellulose powder may naturally remain as sediment.

Remember, a little BetterStevia™ goes a long way.

Store in a cool, dry place after opening.

name: Niacin B Gel 50ml
description_html:
Niacin B is a clear, light textured topical Vitamin B3 gel that can be used at any time of the day be it morning or nigh.

It contains 5% Niacinamide, an effective anti-inflammatory, anti-aging agent in managing acne, hyperpigmentation, fine lines, wrinkles and other inflammatory or age-related skin conditions.

Niacinamide is a form of Vitamin B3 that’s also known as nicotinamide. It’s a water-soluble ingredient that works with the skin’s natural substances to help repair its protective barrier function. Niacinamide can: –

  • Helps skin make more collagen, ceramides and hyaluronic acid;
  • Boosts skin hydration by reducing Trans Epidermal Water Loss;
  • Reduces signs of ageing, enlarged pores, wrinkles and hyper-pigmentation;
  • Reduces inflammation in mild to moderate acne just as well as, prescription-only treatments;
  • Limits overproduction of sebum in oily skin;
  • And more importantly is compatible with many skin actives ingredients hence easy to incorporate in your routine with less reaction.

Niacin In Acne Management.

The standard approach to acne treatments consists of modalities targeting excessive oil production, reducing bacterial infection, reducing inflammation and exfoliation to remove dead skin cells.

While all of these treatments are well-intended and effective, they often have predictable side effects which include dryness, redness, peeling, irritation and skin sensitivity making the therapy a bit intolerable to most patients.

Niacinamide’s soothing and anti-inflammatory properties make it an attractive ADD-ON to the standard Acne treatments in an effort to increase efficacy and tolerability.

Studies have shown that Niacinamide can benefit acne prone skin because:

  • It increases epidermal production ceramides which in turn improves the integrity of the lipid layer and epidermal barrier allowing for a normalized moisture balance. This is an important component when treating acne given most topical treatments used do result in dryness and moisture imbalance.
  • Acne is an inflammatory condition that often leads to numerous pimples with delayed healing and scarring. Niacinamide has anti-inflammatory properties that can reduce the overall inflammatory response, resulting in fewer pimples.
  • Dysregulation of sebum can result in excessively oily skin and subsequently more acne lesions. Having a good balance of oil and moisture within acne-prone skin is an important component for controlling the acne. Studies have shown 2% Niacinamide regulates excessive production of sebum.
  • Niacinamide can also stabilize the melanosome activity within the cells, which can improve residual hyperpigmentation from acne scars as well as those who suffer from melasma.

description_html:
Organic Flaxseed Omega Oil is made from 100% pure flaxseed (linseed), nothing else is added. Naturally high in omega 3 this is a perfect vegan alternative to obtain the essential omega oils. Recommended to take alongside High Five Multivitamin. First cold pressed, solvent free and nitrogen sealed for freshness. 100% active ingredients formulated by expert nutritionists

lax seed is renowned for being the most concentrated plant source of the unsaturated fatty acids alpha linolenic acid (omega 3), linoleic acid (omega 6), and oleic acid (omega 9). Alpha linolenic acid is particularly important as it contributes to the maintenance of normal blood cholesterol levels.

This highly nutritious oil can be added to fruit or vegetable smoothies, salad dressings, dips, soups or as a condiment drizzled onto vegetables, pasta, rice, potatoes etc... or just taken from the spoon.

  • Digestive health: Flaxseed is a good source of fiber, which can help relieve constipation and improve bowel movements.
  • Heart health: Flaxseed contains omega-3 fatty acids, including alpha-linolenic acid (ALA), which may help lower cholesterol and reduce the risk of heart disease.
  • Blood sugar: Flaxseed may help improve blood sugar control in people with type 2 diabetes.
  • Weight management: Flaxseed can help you feel full faster and manage your weight.
  • Menopause: Flaxseed may help reduce the intensity of symptoms associated with menopause.
  • Skin condition: Flaxseed may improve skin condition.
  • Wound healing: Flaxseed may accelerate wound healing.
  • Vitamins and minerals: Flaxseed contains thiamine, copper, molybdenum, magnesium, and phosphorus.
  • Choline: Flaxseed contains choline, which helps your body's cells communicate with each other.

More than just a multivitamin, Woman 40+ is a vitamin, mineral and phytonutrient combination that blends specially formulated nutrients to help address the needs of women aged over 40, as the body’s hormonal balance begins to change.

categories: First Aid | Analgesics/Pain Reliever > Topical Pain Relievers
description_html:
Cura-Heat Back & Shoulder Pain's heat action lasts for 12 hours and once removed the warmth can continue to offer a further 12 hours of pain relief - that's a full 24 hours. Open the sachet and apply against clothing or underwear where the heat can then radiate through to the skin - decreasing stiffness, relaxing tense aching muscles and improving mobility. Non-medicinal, fragrance-free, and with a thin discreet design, Cura-Heat provides a convenient way to manage your back and shoulder pain.

How do Cura-Heat Heat Patches work?

Cura-Heat contains iron, activated carbon, and water. Once the sachet is opened, these ingredients come into contact with the oxygen in the air and an oxidising reaction occurs the ingredients oxidise and produce heat. The combination of ingredients has been specially formulated to ensure a constant and comforting heat.

Heat therapy has long been used as a method of pain relief. Cura-Heat can deliver heat therapy in an easy-to-use targeted adhesive patch. Cura-Heat works by increasing blood flow to the place of application which reduces pain decreases stiffness and can relax sore muscles.

name: Medisure Steam Inhaler
description_html:
Medisure Steam Inhaler

Medisure Steam Inhaler. The easy way to inhale steam and aromatics Medisure Steam Inhaler is a convenient and simple way to help relieve the symptoms of coughs, colds, flu and blocked sinuses.

Helps to relieve nose and throat congestion, clearing the nasal passages for easier breathing. Steam inhalation has long been a widely used method of clearing the airways, where warming and moisturising effects loosen and soften mucous and catarrh.

Instructions for use: Connect mask section to lid and ensure a secure fit. If required add the recommended amount of inhalent to the cup and carefully follow instructions provided with the inhalant product. With the cup on a firm flat surface add hot water to the cup and fill to around two-thirds full. The water should be very hot but NOT boiling.

Carefully place lid and mask section onto the cup and ensure fit. With the cup held level and held firmly by both handles; place the nose and mouth into the mask section. Breathe in slowly and repeat up to 5 times before taking the nose and mouth well away from the cup and breathing normally for one to two minutes. Repeat this procedure as necessary.

Always consult your doctor about persistent, painful or worrying symptoms. For young children (under 10), use only under advice from your doctor or other healthcare professional. For use with children, ensure that the cup is held by a responsible adult at all times and that cooler water is used in the cup. For older children (over 10) use only under close adult supervision, with cooler water and with child securely seated at a table.

Warnings: Hot water scalds - this item is not suitable for use by children. Thoroughly inspect all parts before first use and before each further use to ensure that there are no signs of wear, damage, defect or foreign particles. Wash all parts before first use.

name: Olbas Oil Inhalant Decongestant 30ml
description_html:
Olbas Oil is a blend of pure plant oils for the relief of bronchial and nasal congestion, hayfever and minor infections of the airways by inhalation. When applied to the skin, Olbas Oil also relieves the symptoms of muscular pain and stiffness including: • backache • sciatica • lumbago • fibrositis (pain, stiffness and tenderness of muscles, tendons and joints) • rheumatic pain.

For a really intense Olbas experience, put a few drops of Olbas Oil in a bowl of hot water, lean over it and cover your head with a towel. It’s enough to clear even the most stubborn of blocked noses.

And there's more to Olbas Oil than powerful decongestant vapours. When you're feeling achy, try massaging in a few drops of Olbas Oil for soothing relief.

. How to use Olbas Oil

It is very important to always use this medicine exactly as described in the leaflet or as your doctor or pharmacist has told you. Check with your doctor or pharmacist if you are not sure. For inhalation and external use on unbroken skin only. ! Do not put drops directly into nose or mouth. If Olbas Oil is accidentally put into the nose or swallowed, seek immediate advice as it can be harmful. ! If Olbas Oil comes into direct contact with the surface of the eye, wash thoroughly and seek immediate medical advice as it can be harmful. See the instructions below for more information on how to use the product correctly. AS AN INHALANT: to clear painful sinuses and relieve nasal congestion.

Adults and children aged 12 and over: Day: Add 2 or 3 drops to a tissue and inhale the vapours. Night: Add 2 or 3 drops to a tissue and leave it inside a pillowcase to inhale throughout the night. Children aged 2 and over: Day: Add 2 or 3 drops to a tissue and hold close to, but not touching, the child to allow child to breathe in vapours. Night: Add 2 or 3 drops to a tissue and place in the bedroom out of the child’s reach to inhale throughout the night

name: Nature's Aid Selenium 200µg 90s
description_html:
A convenient Selenium supplement, with Zinc and Vitamins A, C & E.

One of the key roles that Selenium plays is in protecting cells from oxidative stress, which occurs when there are high levels of free radicals in your body. Your body comes into contact with free radicals every day, their levels can be increased by a wide variety of common activities such as frying foods, drinking alcohol and smoking tobacco, even pesticides and air pollutants cause free radicals to be released into the air you breath. Free radicals can cause damage to your cells, through a process called oxidation.

What’s more, Selenium also contributes to normal sperm production (also known as spermatogenesis), the maintenance of normal hair and nails, the normal function of the immune system and even the normal function of the thyroid gland.

This versatile mineral can be found in Brazil nuts and walnuts, fish, beef, poultry and grains. However, the Selenium content of food varies dramatically depending on the location that the food is produced. Even the most balanced diet may benefit from a top-up in the form of a supplement. At Natures Aid, our Selenium supplement provides 200µg Selenium per tablet. Our in-house experts have combined Selenium with complementary nutrients for a unique and handy daily supplement; we have included Vitamin A in the form of Beta Carotene, Vitamin C & Vitamin E plus Zinc in a formulation suitable for vegans.

description_html:
USN’s Pure Creatine is a micronized form of creatine, enhancing the absorption and bioavailability. Through Micronization, the molecular structure is reduced hence enhancing its solubility. Pure Creatine is designed to support protein synthesis which aids muscle gains, enhance recovery and improve physical performance. Micronized creatine is absorbed faster and better than other compounds of creatine.

Benefits
USN Micronized Creatine decorate muscle strength, strength, and endurance, enhance workout performance, and doubtlessly contribute to muscle boom when used alongside resistance schooling.
Glutamine is a conditionally essential amino acid which is broken down & lost quickly during intense physical activity.

Supplementing with PURE GLUTAMINE aids in:
Enhancing Strength & Recovery
Recommended Usage
  • Take 1 teaspoon early in the morning and before or after training.
  • For creatine loading: for the first 5 days of use, take 1 teaspoon 4–5 times per day with 250 ml of your favourite protein/carbohydrate drink or grape juice.
  • For creatine level maintenance: after 5 consecutive days of loading, take 1 teaspoon 1–2 times per day with 250 ml of your favourite protein/carbohydrate drink or grape juice.
  • During loading and maintenance: take 1 of the servings before and/or after training.

name: USN Hyperbolic Mass gH French Vanilla 6kg
description_html:
Product Information

Hyperbolic Mass is a comprehensive mass-building formula tailored for those with rapid metabolisms. Its advanced amino acid blend, fortified with glutamine, accelerates muscle recovery and growth. Packed with protein and featuring a four-phase carbohydrate system, it provides sustained energy and optimal nutrient delivery. Beta-alanine is included to enhance athletic performance and power output.

Ingredients
Creatine monohydrate: can help muscle cells produce more energy, can improve high-intensity exercise performance and speed up muscle growth.


Di-creatine malate: highly soluble source of creatine that delivers cell volumising nutrients to every muscle in the body.

L-glycine: a component of creatine, main amino acid in collagen, can protect against muscle loss.

BCAAs: branched-chain amino acids used by the body in protein synthesis. Assists in muscle building and recovery.

HMB (Beta-hydroxy betamethylbutyrate): protects and repairs muscle tissue.

L-glutamine: reduces soreness and stiffness in muscles.

Beta-alanine: speeds up muscle growth.

Avena sativa: may improve mood, can relieve anxiety, may improve blood flow and may reduce inflammation.

Recommended Use


  • To start: add ±2 scoops (150 g) to 375–450 ml of cold water or full cream milk.
  • After a week: add ±4 scoops (300 g) with 750–900 ml water or full cream milk (divided between 2 small shakers).
  • Take a full 300 g serving once daily or as divided dosages. Use as a recovery drink post-training and/or in-between meals.

Substituting water with 800 ml full cream milk will add 26 g protein and 2.4 g leucine per serving.

description_html:
Collagen is the major component of many tissues in your body and accounts for 80% of the dry weight of your skin, providing it with its strength and structure. Our natural Collagen production starts to slow as we age, and diet and lifestyle habits such as eating high levels of sugar or refined carbohydrates, sun damage and smoking can damage your Collagen.

Vitamin C plays a role in supporting healthy collagen formation, so it is important to maintain healthy levels either by choosing Vitamin C rich foods, such as citrus fruits, peppers, and strawberries. As your body cannot store Vitamin C, it must be consumed daily, and supplements which contain Vitamin C can be used as a top up, if you feel your diet may be falling short. · Vitamin C, Copper and Vitamins B2 & B3 which all contribute to the maintenance of normal skin.

· Zinc contributes to the maintenance of normal skin, hair & nails.

· Biotin contributes to the maintenance of normal skin and hair.

This carefully crafted supplement contains only hydrolysed type 2 marine Collagen, sourced from skate wings and chosen due to the belief that it is absorbed by the body more efficiently than other forms of Collagen available. Choosing hydrolysed collagen means this supplement is more easily digested and absorbed by your body, because our hydrolysed Collagen has been broken down into smaller particles.

Our hydrolysed, marine sourced Collagen Beauty Formula is guaranteed to be free from GMO and common allergens including gluten, dairy, yeast, nuts and soya, for your peace of mind.

Direction Of Use:

Take 1 capsule per day with water. Do not exceed the recommended intake.

name: USN Hyperbolic Mass gH Dutch Chocolate 2kg
description_html:
Product Information

Hyperbolic Mass is a comprehensive mass-building formula tailored for those with rapid metabolisms. Its advanced amino acid blend, fortified with glutamine, accelerates muscle recovery and growth. Packed with protein and featuring a four-phase carbohydrate system, it provides sustained energy and optimal nutrient delivery. Beta-alanine is included to enhance athletic performance and power output.

Ingredients
Creatine monohydrate: can help muscle cells produce more energy, can improve high-intensity exercise performance and speed up muscle growth.


Di-creatine malate: highly soluble source of creatine that delivers cell volumising nutrients to every muscle in the body.

L-glycine: a component of creatine, main amino acid in collagen, can protect against muscle loss.

BCAAs: branched-chain amino acids used by the body in protein synthesis. Assists in muscle building and recovery.

HMB (Beta-hydroxy betamethylbutyrate): protects and repairs muscle tissue.

L-glutamine: reduces soreness and stiffness in muscles.

Beta-alanine: speeds up muscle growth.

Avena sativa: may improve mood, can relieve anxiety, may improve blood flow and may reduce inflammation.

Recommended Use


  • To start: add ±2 scoops (150 g) to 375–450 ml of cold water or full cream milk.
  • After a week: add ±4 scoops (300 g) with 750–900 ml water or full cream milk (divided between 2 small shakers).
  • Take a full 300 g serving once daily or as divided dosages. Use as a recovery drink post-training and/or in-between meals.

Substituting water with 800 ml full cream milk will add 26 g protein and 2.4 g leucine per serving.

name: Valupak Calcium & Vitamin D Chewable Tablets 30's
description_html:
Vitamin D is a prohormone, which is the precursor to a hormone. In its raw form (sun exposure, foods, supplements), Vitamin D is inert and has to go through a series of complex biochemical reactions before your body can use it. These reactions produce calcitriol, which is the form of Vitamin D that is used by your body (D2 and D3).

Vitamin D is one of the only vitamins that your body can produce by itself. What is the catalyst that gets your D production going? Good old fashioned sunshine! It’s the ultraviolet-B radiation (UVB) that enables vitamin D production to occur in the skin.

Vitamin D is produced in equal amounts in both people with fairly pigmented and darkly pigmented skin after exposure to UVB radiation (sunlight). Sunlight is important for Vitamin D production, but the strength of sunlight and the intensity of UVB exposure can be affected by season, distance from the equator, and even personal habits. If you have a job that keeps you indoors during daylight hours, or you work nights, you don’t produce as much Vitamin D as someone who is outside for at least ten to fifteen minutes each day.

Vitamin D can be supplemented by eating the right foods. See my previous blogpost about foods containing Vitamin D.

Vitamin D plays an important role in bone building by enabling calcium uptake by your body. It is also very important for healthy immune system function and may help lower your risk of contracting colds. Vitamin D also helps confer innate immunity which may protect your body from the influenza virus.

Vitamin D has been linked to the prevention of many different diseases, including multiple sclerosis, arthritis and even cancer. Children with higher vitamin D levels are less likely to suffer from asthma and allergies than those who are vitamin D deficient. Mental agility might be maintained by adequate levels of the vitamin, especially in the elderly.

Calcium is necessary for maintenance of normal bones and teeth. Vitamin D, whilst aiding in calcium absorption, also contributes to the maintenance of normal bones and teeth.

name: Snoreeze Snoring Relief Nasal Strips - Large 10 Applications
description_html:
This provides effective snoring relief for up to 8 hours, which means no more bleary-eyed 7am arguments.

Recommended For

You have a blocked nose

You suffer with congestion

You snore when lying on your side as well as on your back

You’ve been diagnosed with a nasal abnormality

How It Works:

Colds and allergies are a common cause of snoring. Along with seasonal allergies, many people also have an allergic reaction to bed dust/mites that they are unaware of.

When nasal tissue swells during a cold (or allergic reaction), the airflow through the nose becomes blocked or restricted. This congestion narrows your airway, forcing the air you breathe to travel faster and further dehydrate the tissue. This may force you to breathe through your mouth – and this can lead to a dry mouth, and snoring.

Snoreeze Nasal Strips target this type of snoring by gently opening the airways and improving airflow to provide effective snoring relief for up to 8 hours.

name: Erovita HIV Cassette Kit 25's
description_html:
Erovita HIV Self Test is a home-use HIV testing kit that allows you to test yourself for HIV (human immunodeficiency virus) in the privacy of your own home. HIV is a virus that can lead to AIDS (acquired immune deficiency syndrome) if left untreated. The Sure Check HIV Self Test is designed to detect the presence of HIV antibodies in a person's blood.

To use the test, you will need to collect a small sample of blood using the lancet and test strip provided in the kit. The test strip is inserted into the test reader, and the results are displayed within 15 minutes. The test is over 99% accurate when used according to the instructions.

It is important to note that the Erovita HIV Self-Test is not intended to diagnose HIV infection. If you test positive on the self-test, you should contact your healthcare provider for further testing and treatment. If you test negative, it is still important to practice safe sex and to get tested regularly to ensure that you remain HIV-negative.

description_html:
CARNIVITA FORTE to enhance their vitality and assist their body’s natural processes. This product comes in a pack containing 30 tablets, designed for convenient daily intake.

CARNIVITA FORTE primarily features L-carnitine as a key ingredient. L-carnitine is a naturally occurring amino acid derivative that plays a vital role in the body’s energy metabolism. Specifically, L-carnitine actively helps transport fatty acids into the mitochondria of cells. Mitochondria are like the powerhouses of cells, where they burn fat to create usable energy. Therefore, CARNIVITA FORTE can assist the body in efficiently converting fat into energy, which may lead to improved stamina and reduced fatigue.

– To protect against muscle disease and stamina during heavy exercise & improve performance during physical effort.

Dosage:
One tablet to be taken one to three times a day with a meal or according to the physician’s directions.
* Store in a dry cool place, at a temperature not exceeding (below) 30 degrees C. Keep in its blister packing and avoid moisture

Andolex-C Lozenges is used for the symptomatic relief of minor infections and painful conditions of the mouth and throat.

Do not chew or swallow Andolex-C Lozenges whole. It should be slowly dissolved in the mouth. Naso-pharyngeal and bucco-pharyngeal antiseptics.

name: Vaseline Vitamin B3 Body Oil 200ML
description_html:
Vaseline Vitamin B3 Oil is a skincare product designed to provide moisturization and improve the overall appearance of the skin. Here's a detailed description of its features and benefits:

Key Ingredients:
1. **Vitamin B3 (Niacinamide):**
- This ingredient is known for its skin-brightening properties. It helps to reduce the appearance of dark spots, uneven skin tone, and dullness. Vitamin B3 also has anti-inflammatory properties that can help to soothe irritated skin and strengthen the skin barrier.

2. **Vaseline Jelly (Petrolatum):**
- This is a key moisturizing ingredient that helps to lock in moisture, creating a protective barrier on the skin's surface. It prevents moisture loss and keeps the skin hydrated for longer periods.

Benefits:
- **Hydration:** The oil helps to deeply moisturize the skin, making it feel soft, smooth, and supple.
-ensitive **Skin Brightening:** With regular use, Vitamin B3 can help to brighten the skin tone and reduce the appearance of dark spots.

- **Skin Protection:** The Vaseline Jelly component acts as a protective barrier, shielding the skin from environmental stressors and preventing dryness.

- **Soothing:** The product can help to calm and soothe irritated or skin due to the anti-inflammatory properties of Vitamin B3.

Texture and Application:
- The oil has a lightweight, non-greasy texture that absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving a heavy or sticky residue.
- It can be applied directly to the skin, usually after cleansing, and can be used on both the face and body.
- Suitable for daily use, especially for individuals with dry or sensitive skin.

Usage:
- The oil is versatile and can be used as a part of your daily skincare routine, either alone or under a moisturizer.
- It can also be mixed with your regular moisturizer for added hydration.

Target Audience:
- Ideal for individuals with dry, dull, or uneven skin tone, or for those looking to brighten their complexion and improve overall skin health.

description_html: Product Description Fervex Adult is suitable for relieving common cold, rhinitis and flu-like conditions in adults (ages 15 and over), e.g.: – clear nasal discharge and watering eyes; – sneezing; and – headaches and/or fever. How to Use For oral use. Powder must be dissolved in a sufficient quantity of water (hot or cold) and solution drunk. Dosage 1 sachet, 2 or 3 times per day. Leave at least 4 hours between doses. – If you have severe kidney dysfunction (with a rate of creatinine clearance below 10 ml per minute), leave at least 8 hours between doses. If using for flu relief, it is preferable to take this medicine with hot water in the evening. Length of Treatment Do not use for longer than 5 days. Ingredients Per sachet: Paracetamol – 0.500 g Ascorbic acid (a form of vitamin C) – 0.200 g Pheniramine maleate – 0.025 g Excipients QS Excipients with recognised effect: sucrose, Orange Yellow S (E110) Packaging This medicine is produced in the form of a powder for drinkable solution and sold in packs of 8 sachets. Contra-indications Do NOT use: – if you are under 15; – if you are allergic to any of the ingredients; – if you have certain types of glaucomas (increases in fluid pressure in the eye); – if you have difficulty passing urine (e.g. due to prostate problems); – if you have serious liver or kidney disease – this medicine contains paracetamol; or – if you are fructose-intolerant, or have glucose-galactose malabsorption or a sucrase-isomaltase deficiency (rare metabolic disorders) – this medicine contains sucrose. If you are pregnant or breast-feeding, you should generally avoid using this medicine unless recommended by your doctor. In addition, you should avoid alcohol, all medicines containing alcohol, and all sedative medicines while using this medicine. If you are pregnant or breast-feeding: Use of this medicine while pregnant or breast-feeding is not recommended. If you drive: This is an AFSSAPS (Agence française de sécurité sanitaire des produits de santé) Level 2 medicine. Use with caution. name: L’Oreal Paris Glycolic Bright Serum 30Ml
description_html:
Formulated with glycolic acid, this serum for dark spots penetrates deep into the skin, stimulates cell renewal, and evens out the layer of skin where melanin starts to build up. The glycolic acid serum for uneven skin tone is clinically proven to remove up to five years of dark spots in just a few weeks.

As you age, the skin’s natural ability to regenerate cells reduces, leading to an increase in melanin production. Melanin is the pigment that gives your skin its color and when the excess pigment is deposited deep within the skin, it leads to uneven skin, dark spots, and hyperpigmentation. The presence of glycolic acid in this hyperpigmentation serum helps to even out the basal layer of the skin where melanin starts to build up. This highly effective serum helps to improve three dimensions of even-toned skin and removes dark spots in just a few weeks. It is great for daily use, dermatologically tested, and suitable for all skin types. So, make the skin brightening serum a part of your regular skincare routine and flaunt glowing skin effortlessly.

name: Fixodent Plus Unbeatable Bite Cream No Flavour 40g
description_html:
Descriptions
Fixodent Plus Unbeatable Bite 40 g is an adhesive cream for total and partial dentures. It provides long-lasting, unbeatable bonding all day long, so you can feel confident and spontaneous. Neutral taste.

Directions for use
Read the instructions before use. Clean and dry your dentures before applying the adhesive cream. Apply the adhesive cream in thin, continuous lines as shown in the instructions, or even less. You will probably need to do a few tests before you find the right amount. Insert the denture and hold it in place for a few seconds. When you put it in your mouth, if the product overflows, you've put in too much. To remove your denture, rinse your mouth with lukewarm water, move the denture around until it comes loose.

Precautions for use
Do not use more product than shown in the diagram (for a full denture, 6 lines maximum or a total length of approximately 7.5 cm). If the product runs over the denture once it is in place, you are using too much product. Do not use too much product on ill-fitting dentures. Consult your dentist regularly to ensure that your dentures fit properly. Poorly fitted dentures can damage your health. Do not use the product more than once a day.

Composition
calcium, zinc, pvm/ma copolymer (35%), paraffinum liquidum, cellulose gum, petrolatum, silica, ci 45410.

Clean your hair with just a few sprays of this fan favorite. Its happy and summery scent gets you ready to face the world, while dreaming of vacation. name: Gluconova Travi-Go Aud/Rx Glucose Test Strips 50's
description_html:
Measures Glucose (Sugar) In Your Blood. These test strips are designed for the quantitative measurement of blood glucose levels in fresh capillary, venous, arterial, and neonatal blood samples. The strips are intended for self-testing by individuals with diabetes or by healthcare professionals to monitor blood sugar levels.

The strips utilize a GDH-FAD enzyme biosensor, which provides high accuracy and reliable results. With a small sample volume of just 0.5 µL, they are designed to be user-friendly and provide results in approximately 5 seconds. The test strips are typically sold in two vials of 25 strips to maintain their quality and prevent degradation from exposure to light, air, and moisture. They are "no-coding" strips, which means they do not require a separate code chip to be inserted into the meter, making the testing process faster and simpler.

description_html:
he Ducray Neoptide Expert Serum is a dual-action, leave-in treatment for chronic hair loss and growth stimulation in both men and women.

Key Features & Benefits
  • Dual Action: Formulated to both slow down hair loss and stimulate new hair growth.
  • Strengthens & Densifies: The serum helps to strengthen hair fibers, increase volume, and improve hair density and resilience. Clinical results have established its effectiveness in regulating hair loss and improving density after two months of proper application.
  • Main Ingredients: It contains patented natural active ingredients:
    • Anchorane™ (milk thistle extract): Stimulates hair growth and improves hair anchorage to the scalp.
    • Lespedeza: A natural active ingredient that helps normalize and regulate the hair cycle to slow down hair loss.
    • Mangalidone: Combined with massage, it promotes scalp microcirculation and metabolic activity.

Apply the serum once a day to the scalp, which can be either dry or damp.

  • For Hair Transplantation Support: A specific application protocol is recommended involving use before and after the procedure.
  • Application Method: Gently massage the product into the scalp with your fingertips to ensure absorption. Do not rinse.
  • Duration: For optimal results, a daily application for a minimum of 3 months is recommended.

categories: Multi Vitamins > Energy, Brain & Nervous System
description_html:
These capsules from Doppelherz® aktiv contain a unique combination of the omega-3 fatty acids EPA and DHA, ginkgo leaves extract, B-vitamins and vitamin E.

The omega-3 fatty acids EPA and DHA are involved in the correct function of the heart and of the brain. Regular intake of these fatty acids contributes to maintain cardiovascular system health as well as brain performances.

Ginkgo leaves have long been considered in Asia as a mental stimulant. This is likely because ginkgo contains secondary metabolites that act on the vascular system to stimulate peripheral blood flow. Proper irrigation of the brain with oxygen-rich blood is a key determinant to keep good learning and cognitive abilities.

Vitamins B1, B12, niacin and pantothenic acid are required for the proper function of the nervous system. Intake of these B-vitamins is therefore important to maintain vigorous brain activity.

Vitamin E helps protect cell membranes from oxidative assaults and thereby contributes to the normal function of nerve and muscle cells.

Daily intake of two Mega Brain capsules from Doppelherz® aktiv provides nutrients, which are helpful to remain physically healthy and mentally alert.

description_html:
Nicorette® Inhalator works to relieve cravings and nicotine withdrawal symptoms associated with a dependence on tobacco. It s a form of Nicotine Replacement Therapy (NRT) that provides a low level of nicotine to help reduce withdrawal symptoms without chemicals such as tar, carbon monoxide, ammonia and lead contained in tobacco smoke.

How Nicorette® Inhalator works:

  • Air is drawn through the inhalator when you inhale with deep or shallow puffs;

  • The inhalator releases nicotine, which is vaporised;

  • Nicotine is absorbed through your mouth's lining into your body;

Less nicotine is released from a puff on an inhalator than a drag on a cigarette, so it may be necessary to inhale more often than when smoking.

name: Alka- Seltzer XS 20'S
description_html:
These tablets contain three active ingredients that work to provide relief. These are: Aspirin, Paracetamol, Caffeine. Aspirin and paracetamol are both painkillers, with aspirin being what is known as a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) which are used to reduce pain and inflammation. Paracetamol can also be used to reduce fever. Caffeine is an ingredient that works as a mild stimulant and can also improve the effectiveness of paracetamol as a painkiller. These tablets are suitable for adults and children aged 16 and over. They should not be used by anyone who is allergic to the ingredients contained in them. They should also not be used if any of the following apply to you:
Are allergic to any other NSAIDs
Have a disorder such as haemophilia, which causes excessive bleeding
Have, or in the past had, a stomach ulcer
Are taking a high dose of methotrexate, 15mg or more
These tablets should not be used by anyone pregnant or breastfeeding unless advised to do so by a doctor.

name: Driclor Antiperspirant Roll On Applicator 20ml
description_html:
Driclor Roll-On is a high-strength, clinical-strength antiperspirant designed to treat excessive sweating (hyperhidrosis) on the underarms, hands, and feet. It works by forming a gel plug in sweat glands, reducing output. Apply to completely dry skin at night, washing it off in the morning.
Key Details:
  • Active Ingredient: Aluminum chloride hexahydrate.
  • Usage: Apply nightly initially, then reduce to 1-2 times weekly for maintenance.
  • Results: Visible improvement usually within 1-2 weeks.
  • Caution: Avoid broken, irritated, or freshly shaved skin (wait 24 hours). It may cause stinging or irritation.

  • Driclor anti-perspirant roll on is suitable for use on all skin types and by anyone for whom traditional anti-perspirants are inadequate.

    How to use

    • Always dry the affected areas thoroughly before applying (otherwise irritation may occur)
    • Initially apply once daily, last thing at night
    • In the morning, wash off and do not reapply during the day. Continue to use your regular deodorant as normal.
    • After 2 weeks, you should notice as considerable improvement. Once sweating stops during the day, you can reduce applications to twice a week or less.

    Hazardous

    • Not for use by children under 3 years.
    • Do not apply to wet, broken, sensitive, irritated or recently shaven skin.
    • Avoid contact with the eyes.
    • Keep away from open flames.
    • Avoid direct contact with costume jewellery, polished metal surfaces and clothing.

name: Health Aid Vitamin D3 200iu Drops 15ml
description_html:
Vitamin D is a fat-soluble vitamin, which can be created by the body when the skin is exposed to sunshine for a small amount of time. Certain factors such as the amount of melanin found in your skin, limited sun exposure and lack of Vitamin D in foods can deplete Vitamin D stored within the body over time. A lack of Vitamin D can lead to symptoms such as lethargy, tiredness, muscle problems, bone pains and mood changes.

Vitamin D is important for a range of bodily functions, and supplementation alongside a healthy diet can contribute to the normal absorption and utilisation of Calcium and Phosphorus, which is important for the maintenance of normal bones and teeth. Vitamin D is also used within the body to maintain the normal functioning of the immune system, cell division, and helps maintain normal muscle function. HealthAid® Vitamin D Drops are perfect for children and those who are unable to swallow tablets.

  • Contributes to the normal function of the immune system
  • Contributes to the maintenance of normal bones and teeth
  • Contributes to the maintenance of normal muscle function
  • Contributes to the normal absorption and utilisation of Calcium and Phosphorus
  • Has a role in the process of cell division

Recommended Daily Intake

Children from birth to 1 year, one drop daily to be given orally, or added to water or juice. Children from 1 to 12 years can increase up to two drops daily on the advice of a medical professional. Adults and children over 12 years, one to five drops daily. Do not exceed recommended daily intake unless advised by a suitably qualified person.

Free From Corn, Gluten, Dairy, Yeast, Lactose, Starch, Wheat, Artificial Colours and Flavourings.

name: Blue Cross Meftal Spas Tablets, 60’S
description_html:
Meftal Spas is a specialized combination medication designed to provide rapid relief from smooth muscle spasms and gastrointestinal distress. It is frequently utilized for managing menstrual cramps and various forms of abdominal discomfort.

Active Ingredients & Composition

The efficacy of Meftal Spas lies in its dual-action formula:

Dicyclomine (Antispasmodic): Works by relaxing the smooth muscles of the stomach and intestines to stop sudden muscle contractions (spasms).

Simethicone (Anti-foaming agent): Disintegrates gas bubbles in the digestive tract, allowing for easier passage of gas and reducing pressure.

Primary Uses

Highly effective in relieving acute period pain (dysmenorrhea).

Eases stomach cramps and soothes lower abdominal discomfort.

Specifically targets and reduces the feeling of fullness and bloating caused by excess gas.

Dosage:

Take1 tablet up to 3 times daily, preferably before meals, or as strictly directed by a healthcare professional.

Common Side Effects:

Users may experience mild, temporary symptoms such as dry mouth, dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, or blurred vision.

Contraindications:

Avoid if you have glaucoma, myasthenia gravis, or urinary blockages.

Consult a doctor before use if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

Avoid if you have a known allergy to dicyclomine or simethicone.

name: Blue Cross Meftal Tablets 500Mg
description_html:
Meftal-500 is a 500mg uncoated tablet of Mefenamic Acid, a member of the Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drug (NSAID) class. It is specifically engineered to provide symptomatic relief from acute pain, fever, and various inflammatory conditions in both adolescents and adults.

Mechanism of Action

Mefenamic Acid works by inhibiting prostaglandin synthesis. Prostaglandins are chemicals in the body that signal pain and trigger inflammation and fever; by blocking their production, Meftal-500 effectively reduces these symptoms at the source.

Primary Indications

This medication is indicated for a wide range of conditions, including:

Targeted relief for moderate to severe menstrual cramps.

Manages pain associated with muscles, joints, and soft tissue injuries.

Provides effective recovery-phase analgesia after surgical or dental procedures.

Reduces high body temperatures associated with fever.

Recommended Dose: 500mg taken three times daily.

Administration: It is highly recommended to take the tablet after food to minimize potential gastrointestinal irritation.

name: Blue Cross Sonaderm GM Cream 10g
description_html:
Sonaderm-L Skin Cream (30 gm) is a potent antifungal medication primarily used to treat skin infections such as ringworm, jock itch, and athlete’s foot. These infections occur when fungi attack skin tissue, often causing contagious conditions that can spread between individuals.

Mechanism of Action

The cream contains Luliconazole, which effectively kills fungi by targeting the fungal cell membrane. It works by creating holes in these membranes, preventing unwanted substances from entering the cells while stopping the leakage of vital cell contents, thereby clearing the infection.

Usage & Administration

ü Apply a small amount as a thin layer on the clean, dry affected area using a finger.

ü This product is for external use; avoid contact with the nose, mouth, eyes, or vagina.

ü Do not exceed the recommended dose and consult a doctor if you are allergic to any ingredients or are pregnant/nursing.

ü It is not recommended for children under 12 years of age without a direct doctor's prescription.

Side Effects

Some users may experience localized reactions at the application site, including:

Redness or swelling.

Irritation or a burning sensation.

Most side effects are mild and resolve over time, but medical attention should be sought if they persist or worsen.

Disclaimer: Always consult your doctor or pharmacist before beginning any new medication to ensure it is appropriate for your specific health profile.

categories: First Aid > Bandage & Dressings | First Aid > Band Aids and Bandages
description_html:
Curafix® i.v. Control is a specialized, skin-friendly cannula fixation plaster designed by Lohmann & Rauscher. It is specifically engineered to provide secure stabilization for intravenous catheters while maintaining a high standard of moisture management and site visibility.

Key Features & Benefits

· The dressing is impermeable to water but remains permeable to water vapor. A porous adhesive coating further reduces moisture accumulation.

· Due to its breathability, the risk of skin maceration is particularly low compared to standard non-permeable dressings.

· It features a transparent viewing window that allows healthcare providers to inspect the puncture site for signs of infection or displacement without removing the plaster.

· A specialized recess on the patch is designed for the additional stabilization of cannulas, ensuring they remain in place during patient movement.

Each fixation bandage is individually sterile-packed to ensure patient safety.

categories: First Aid > Bandage & Dressings | First Aid > Band Aids and Bandages
description_html:
The Debrisoft Lolly is a specialized tool developed for the effective debridement of deep wounds, hard-to-reach areas, and for use during invasive surgery. It is designed to remove debris, biofilm, and exudate quickly and intuitively, ensuring a clean wound bed to facilitate healing.

Mechanism of Action & Usage

The Debrisoft Lolly simplifies complex debridement through a straightforward two-step process:

Step A (Application): The soft head of the Debrisoft Lolly is moistened and applied to the wound or hard-to-reach area with gentle pressure.

Step B (Absorption): The specialized fiber composite absorbs and traps loosened wound coatings and debris within the head.

Key Advantages

· Provides thorough debridement of deep and difficult-to-access areas.

· Delivers visible improvements in a short timeframe, typically between 2 to 4 minutes.

· Specifically engineered to disrupt and remove harmful biofilm.

· Noted for its intuitive handling and high rates of user satisfaction due to its ease of use.

Disclaimer: Debrisoft Lolly should be used by or under the guidance of a healthcare professional, especially during invasive surgical procedures.

categories: First Aid > Bandage & Dressings | First Aid > Band Aids and Bandages
description_html:
The Debrisoft Pad is a specialized, soft debridement tool engineered to remove barriers to wound healing. It is designed to safely and virtually painlessly eliminate dead skin cells, bacteria, and debris while maintaining the integrity of healthy, intact tissue.

Mechanism of Action

The efficacy of the Debrisoft Pad is driven by its proprietary monofilament fibre technology™:

The pad contains millions of fibers, each precisely cut and angled at varying lengths. These fibers are specifically designed to lift, bind, and remove bacteria and skin keratoses from the wound bed. In addition to physical debris, the pad effectively absorbs wound exudate during the debridement process.

Indications

· The 10cm x 10cm pad is specifically optimized for treating shallow wounds.

· It is ideal for use on easily accessible skin surfaces and wound sites.

· Helps clear the wound of bacterial loads that often stall the healing process.

Key Benefits

· Offers a virtually painless experience for patients compared to traditional mechanical debridement.

· Effectively targets non-viable tissue while protecting newly formed, healthy granulating tissue.

Facilitates quick and thorough cleaning of the wound bed to accelerate recovery.
