name: Lohmann & Rauscher Suprasob A+Ag Antimicrobial CA-ALG Dressing 10X10cm 10's
categories: First Aid > Bandage & Dressings | First Aid > Band Aids and Bandages
description_html:
Suprasorb® A is a high-performance calcium alginate dressing designed specifically for the management of heavily exuding (leaking) wounds. It is highly absorbent and becomes a gel-like consistency upon contact with wound fluid, which helps maintain a moist environment conducive to healing.

1. Suprasorb® A (Standard)

Made from natural calcium alginate fibers (derived from brown algae).

When it absorbs wound exudate, an exchange of calcium and sodium ions occurs, turning the dressing into a clear, moist gel.

Benefits:

· Manages large volumes of fluid, reducing the risk of skin maceration (softening/breaking down of the surrounding skin).

· The soft fibers easily tuck into deep or irregularly shaped wounds.

· The gel layer prevents the dressing from sticking to the wound bed, making dressing changes less painful.

2. Suprasorb® A + Ag (Antimicrobial)

· Calcium alginate fibers supplemented with silver (Ag).

· It functions identically to the standard version but releases silver ions when it gels.

Benefits:

· The silver provides a broad-spectrum antimicrobial effect, killing bacteria within the dressing and the wound bed.

· Effective against MRSA and VRE, making it ideal for wounds that are critically colonized or showing signs of infection.

Indications

These dressings are typically used for both superficial and deep wounds, including:

· Pressure ulcers

· Arterial and venous leg ulcers

· Diabetic foot ulcers

· Post-operative wounds

· Skin graft donor sites

Application Tips

· Cleanse the wound according to standard protocols.

· Cut or fold the dressing to fit the wound size. For deep wounds, loosely pack the dressing (do not "stuff" it tightly, as it expands when wet).

· Since alginates do not have an adhesive border and can dry out, they must be covered with a secondary dressing (e.g., a foam dressing or transparent film) to keep them in place and maintain moisture.

· The dressing should be changed when it has completely turned to gel or when fluid begins to leak through the secondary dressing (usually every 1–3 days depending on exudate levels).

Note: Alginate dressings should not be used on dry wounds or wounds with minimal drainage, as they can stick to the tissue and cause trauma upon removal.

name: Lohmann & Rauscher Suprasob A+Ag Antimicrobial CA-ALG Dressing 10X20cm 5's
categories: First Aid > Bandage & Dressings | First Aid > Band Aids and Bandages
description_html:
Suprasorb® A is a high-performance calcium alginate dressing designed specifically for the management of heavily exuding (leaking) wounds. It is highly absorbent and becomes a gel-like consistency upon contact with wound fluid, which helps maintain a moist environment conducive to healing.

1. Suprasorb® A (Standard)

Made from natural calcium alginate fibers (derived from brown algae).

When it absorbs wound exudate, an exchange of calcium and sodium ions occurs, turning the dressing into a clear, moist gel.

Benefits:

· Manages large volumes of fluid, reducing the risk of skin maceration (softening/breaking down of the surrounding skin).

· The soft fibers easily tuck into deep or irregularly shaped wounds.

· The gel layer prevents the dressing from sticking to the wound bed, making dressing changes less painful.

2. Suprasorb® A + Ag (Antimicrobial)

· Calcium alginate fibers supplemented with silver (Ag).

· It functions identically to the standard version but releases silver ions when it gels.

Benefits:

· The silver provides a broad-spectrum antimicrobial effect, killing bacteria within the dressing and the wound bed.

· Effective against MRSA and VRE, making it ideal for wounds that are critically colonized or showing signs of infection.

Indications

These dressings are typically used for both superficial and deep wounds, including:

· Pressure ulcers

· Arterial and venous leg ulcers

· Diabetic foot ulcers

· Post-operative wounds

· Skin graft donor sites

Application Tips

· Cleanse the wound according to standard protocols.

· Cut or fold the dressing to fit the wound size. For deep wounds, loosely pack the dressing (do not "stuff" it tightly, as it expands when wet).

· Since alginates do not have an adhesive border and can dry out, they must be covered with a secondary dressing (e.g., a foam dressing or transparent film) to keep them in place and maintain moisture.

· The dressing should be changed when it has completely turned to gel or when fluid begins to leak through the secondary dressing (usually every 1–3 days depending on exudate levels).

Note: Alginate dressings should not be used on dry wounds or wounds with minimal drainage, as they can stick to the tissue and cause trauma upon removal.

name: Disposable Button ECG Electrodes 100's
description_html:
Disposable ECG electrodes are the industry standard for capturing cardiac electrical activity or other biopotential signals (such as EMG for muscle activity or EEG for brain activity). These sensors act as the interface between the body's ionic currents and the electrical signals required by medical monitoring equipment.

Key Features

· Designed with a metal "stud" or "snap" that securely clicks into standard lead wire connectors. This ensures a stable connection even if the patient moves.

· Most are "pre-gelled" with either a solid gel (which adheres well and leaves less residue) or a wet gel (which provides faster signal acquisition and lower impedance).

· Usually made of medical-grade foam, cloth, or breathable tape. Foam is typically preferred for short-term monitoring or exercise tests due to its fluid resistance.

· The internal sensing element is almost always Ag/AgCl, which provides a stable, low-noise baseline for accurate readings.

Best Practices for Application

· To ensure a clear signal and prevent "artifact" (noise) on the monitor, follow these steps:

· This is the most critical step. Clean the site with mild soap and water or a dedicated prep pad. If the skin is oily or has many dead skin cells, the signal will be poor.

· For optimal contact, hair should be clipped (rather than shaved, which can cause micro-abrasions and irritation) at the electrode site.

· Press the edges of the electrode down firmly, but avoid pressing directly on the center (the gel area) initially to prevent the gel from leaking out and reducing adhesion.

· It is often easier to snap the lead wire onto the electrode before placing the electrode on the patient. This prevents the discomfort of pressing down hard on the patient's chest or limbs to get the snap to click.

description_html: Calcium is a mineral that is an essential part of bones and teeth. The heart, nerves, and blood-clotting systems also need calcium to work. Calcium is commonly taken by mouth for the treatment and prevention of low calcium levels. Low calcium levels result in conditions including muscle cramp, osteoporosis (weak bones due to low bone density), rickets (a condition in children where bones soften and become weak), and osteomalacia (softening of bones and pain). Calcium is sometimes taken by mouth to reduce high levels of the parathyroid hormone (hyperparathyroidism) and treat symptoms of premenstrual syndrome (PMS) along with many other conditions. Magnesium helps to regulate calcium transport and stimulates the secretion of calcitonin, a hormone that aids in the influx of calcium into bone. It plays an important role in protein formation and healthy muscle function.

name: Vichy Dercos Densi-Solutions Hair Mass Creator 100ML
categories: Personal Care > Hair Care > Hair Hygiene | Personal Care > Hair Care > Shampoo
description_html:
The Vichy Dercos Densi-Solutions Hair Mass Recreating Concentrate (often called the Hair Mass Creator) is a 100ml intensive, leave-in scalp treatment designed for weak, thinning, and sparse hair to increase hair density, volume, and fullness.

Key Ingredients

Stemoxydine (Diethyllutidinate): A patented molecule that targets the environment of hair follicles to help reawaken dormant follicles and increase hair mass over time.

Resveratrol: A potent antioxidant derived from grapes that helps protect and strengthen the scalp against outside damage.

Rhamnose & Menthol: Plant-derived sugars and cooling agents that improve scalp elasticity, soothe the skin, and stimulate the roots via massage.

Main Benefits

Visibly Thicker Hair: Plumps and coats sparse strands from the root.

Improved Density: Multiplies the look and feel of overall hair mass within weeks.

Stimulated Scalp: Creates a healthy growth environment without adding heavy weight or grease.

How to Use

  • Divide dry or towel-dried hair into sections.
  • Apply about 5 sprays/pumps directly across the scalp (up to 20 pumps total per session).
  • Gently massage into the roots with your fingertips.
  • Do not rinse out; style as normal.
  • Use regularly (roughly 5 days a week) as part of the full Densi-Solutions line
